release_notes:
**Add Speedometer/Speed Limit Widget** now renders one circular dial with a Waze speed-limit badge for original Waze 5.27.5.0.

Add **Waze Speedometer** from the Android home-screen widget picker. With precise location granted, tracking starts as part of placement and stops when the active widget is removed or the screen turns off. Tap the dial to start or stop it manually. Android's widget provider callbacks do not report when a user switches apps or home-screen pages.

The widget uses GPS for live speed and Waze for the road limit. Emulator tests verified live speed, placement, removal, screen-off behavior and preservation of an independently opened Waze session. The badge was tested with sample readings.
